title: DSPy Signature Definition
summary: This module defines the core components for creating and managing DSPy signatures, which are declarative specifications for LLM interactions. It includes a metaclass for dynamic signature generation and utilities for handling field definitions, ensuring proper structure and compatibility.

nodes.label: Manage Signature Class Creation
nodes.title: Signature Class Manager
nodes.description: A metaclass that orchestrates the dynamic creation and validation of DSPy Signature classes, handling field definitions, type annotations, and instructions to ensure well-formed LLM interaction specifications.

nodes.label: Convert Field Definitions
nodes.title: Field Definition Converter
nodes.description: Transforms modern Pydantic-based field definitions into legacy DSPy input or output field objects, providing compatibility for older signature structures.

nodes.label: Legacy Input Field Definition
nodes.title: Legacy Input Field
nodes.description: A class representing an older format for defining an input field within a DSPy signature, including its prefix, description, and formatting.

nodes.label: Legacy Output Field Definition
nodes.title: Legacy Output Field
nodes.description: A class representing an older format for defining an output field within a DSPy signature, including its prefix, description, and formatting.

nodes.label: DSPy Signature Class
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: The declarative blueprint for defining the structure of prompts and expected responses for Language Model interactions in DSPy.

nodes.label: Pydantic Field Metadata
nodes.title: Pydantic Field Info
nodes.description: Pydantic's internal object holding metadata and configuration for a model field, used by DSPy for modern field definitions.

nodes.label: Pydantic Base Model
nodes.title: Pydantic Base Model
nodes.description: The foundational class in Pydantic for creating data models with automatic validation and serialization capabilities.

nodes.label: Construct Signature Class
nodes.title: Signature Class Constructor
nodes.description: An internal DSPy utility function responsible for assembling and returning a new DSPy Signature class based on provided specifications.

nodes.label: Base Legacy Field
nodes.title: Legacy Field Base Class
nodes.description: The abstract base class for older DSPy field definitions, providing common attributes and methods for both input and output fields.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Generative Components
groups.description: Components responsible for creating or generating new DSPy Signature classes based on definitions.

groups.label: Analytical & Transformation
groups.title: Analytical & Transformation
groups.description: Components that analyze or transform field definitions, often for compatibility or internal processing.

groups.label: Data Definitions
groups.title: Data Definitions
groups.description: Components that define or represent the structure and metadata of fields within DSPy signatures.
